decision.reason: [ev-6e35b4906b1d] says the cluster name is validated in 1.16 by default, can be bypassed by setting upgradeCompatibility to v1.15 or earlier, and will be strictly enforced from v1.17. So a non-conforming name is checked now, not just deprecated, and the setting is not silently ignored. That makes setting-ignored the wrong kind. The excerpt does not say what fails validation: it could be the Helm install or upgrade (upgrade-blocked) or agent/operator startup (workload-failure). Choosing the correct mandatory kind needs evidence of where the validation runs and how it fails, such as the Helm chart template check or the agent config validation code or docs.
